# Vexvane Studio

Vexvane Studio develops CranePulse, a real-time telemetry and predictive maintenance platform designed specifically for container crane operators at maritime ports. By continuously monitoring crane performance and health, CranePulse enables port equipment managers to anticipate failures and schedule maintenance proactively, minimizing unplanned downtime.

Currently deployed in eight major terminals worldwide, CranePulse has demonstrably reduced crane downtime by 35%, improving berth efficiency and overall container throughput. Key customers include Pacific Harbor Port Authority, Eastreach Terminal Group, and BalticGate Containers.

Founded in 2021, Vexvane Studio recently closed a $7 million Series A round led by OceanTech Ventures to accelerate product development and expand sales. The core team comprises experts in maritime operations, data engineering, and predictive analytics.

Competitors include HarborSense and DockMate Analytics, though Vexvane’s focus on real-time telemetry and fine-grained predictive modeling sets it apart. Open risks involve integration complexity with legacy crane systems and ongoing sensor hardware reliability challenges.
